bedclothes.header: What do I have to bring?
bedclothes.text: Bring a duvet or sleeping bag, mattress cover, pillowcase and towels. Yes, really, bring a duvet or sleeping bag, the thick warm big thing. There's a bedding swap thread in the forum, maybe two elves with transport facilities can help the railway elves?

costs.header: How much does the con cost?
costs.adults: Participants 14 years and older: 135 Euro (3 nights) / 155 Euro (4 nights)
costs.kids: Participants up to 13 years: 115 Euro (3 nights) / 135 Euro (4 nights)

daytimeGuest.header: Is it possible to come as a day guest?
daytimeGuest.text: Yes, day guests are welcome. Please contact the organizers with the information on which days and at which meals you will be present. The price will be calculated for you accordingly.

organizer.header: Who is the organizing the event?
organizer.text: For 2026, several elves / trolls / preservers have agreed to be involved in various organization tasks.

pets.header: What about pets? Can I bring them with me?
pets.text: This is best clarified with the organizers.

registration.header: Where can I find the registration? How does the registration process work?
registration.text: You can find the registration form on the website. Please read the conditions of participation, fill in the form and send it to the address mentioned there (by post or electronically). The bank account data can be found on the registration form. The registration status is usually updated in the forum from time to time.

selfcatering.header: Where does the food come from?
selfcatering.text: It will be a self-catering con again: the con fee includes all meals and a kitchen, we just have to prepare everything ourselves (it's just cheaper to book). Please plan to help. :-)

when.header: When will the con take place?
when.text: The convention will take place from 22 - 25 June 2026.

where.header: Where will the con take place?
where.text: This year's convention will take place at Petershof in Erbuch (Hessen). This convention will be a self-catering con.

workshops.header: Will there be workshops and the usual promotions?
workshops.text: Yes, as long as people can be found who (co-)organize or lead the event. In the forum you can find the current state of planning. Then go to the appropriate subforum.

location.entry: The Petershof is an interesting and rustic fox house with a well-equipped kitchen, 60 beds, many group rooms, lots of nature around it and a fireplace.
